#include <cstdint>

#include "api/compute/common.h"
#include "api/compute/compute_kernel_api.h"
#include "api/compute/eltwise_binary_sfpu.h"
#include "api/compute/tile_move_copy.h"
#include "ckernel.h"
#include "ckernel_ops.h"
#include "llk_math_eltwise_binary_sfpu_params.h"

namespace {

    // re = ar br -+ ai bi, im = +- ar bi +- ai br: SFPMUL's modifier 1 negates.
    inline void complex_mul_face(uint32_t in0, uint32_t in1, uint32_t out) {
        using namespace ckernel;
        constexpr uint32_t L0 = p_sfpu::LREG0, L1 = p_sfpu::LREG1;
        constexpr uint32_t L2 = p_sfpu::LREG2, L3 = p_sfpu::LREG3;
        constexpr uint32_t L4 = p_sfpu::LREG4, L5 = p_sfpu::LREG5;
        constexpr uint32_t L6 = p_sfpu::LREG6, L7 = p_sfpu::LREG7;
        constexpr uint32_t zero = p_sfpu::LCONST_0, one = p_sfpu::LCONST_1;
        // A tile is 64 register rows; +2 selects the odd columns.
        const uint32_t a = in0 * 64, b = in1 * 64, o = out * 64;
        for (uint32_t group = 0; group < 4; ++group) {
            TT_SFPLOAD(L0, 0, ADDR_MOD_7, a);
            TT_SFPLOAD(L1, 0, ADDR_MOD_7, a + 2);
            TT_SFPLOAD(L2, 0, ADDR_MOD_7, b);
            TT_SFPLOAD(L3, 0, ADDR_MOD_7, b + 2);
            TTI_SFPMUL(L0, L2, zero, L4, 0);
            TTI_SFPMUL(L1, L3, zero, L5, 0);
            TTI_SFPMUL(L0, L3, zero, L6, 1);
            TTI_SFPMUL(L1, L2, zero, L7, 0);
            TTI_SFPADD(one, L4, L5, L4, 0);
            TTI_SFPADD(one, L6, L7, L6, 0);
            TT_SFPSTORE(L4, 0, ADDR_MOD_7, o);
            TT_SFPSTORE(L6, 0, ADDR_MOD_7, o + 2);
            TTI_INCRWC(0, 4, 0, 0);
        }
    }

}  // namespace

// Common arguments: groups_base, groups_extra, nr, block.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr uint32_t cb_a = 0, cb_b = 1, cb_out = 16;
    const uint32_t groups_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t groups_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t nr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t block = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = groups_base + (core < groups_extra ? 1 : 0);
    compute_kernel_hw_startup(cb_a, cb_b, cb_out);
    for (uint32_t g = 0; g < count; ++g) {
        cb_wait_front(cb_b, 1);
        for (uint32_t r = 0; r < nr; r += block) {
            cb_wait_front(cb_a, block);
            cb_reserve_back(cb_out, block);
            tile_regs_acquire();
            copy_init(cb_a);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < block; ++i) {
                copy_tile(cb_a, i, i);
            }
            copy_init(cb_b);
            copy_tile(cb_b, 0, block);
            mul_binary_tile_init();
            for (uint32_t i2 = 0; i2 < block; ++i2) {
                MATH((_llk_math_eltwise_binary_sfpu_params_(complex_mul_face, i2, block, i2, VectorMode::RC)));
            }
            tile_regs_commit();
            tile_regs_wait();
            for (uint32_t i3 = 0; i3 < block; ++i3) {
                pack_tile(i3, cb_out);
            }
            tile_regs_release();
            cb_pop_front(cb_a, block);
            cb_push_back(cb_out, block);
        }
        cb_pop_front(cb_b, 1);
    }
}
